verses.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.text: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.text: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.text: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
verses.text: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.

verses.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.text: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

verses.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
verses.text: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.

verses.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.text: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.text: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.text: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;

verses.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.text: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.text: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.text: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.text: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?

verses.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.text: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.text: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.text: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!

verses.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.text: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.

verses.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.text: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.text: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.text: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.text: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.text: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.text: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.text: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.text: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
verses.text: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.text: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.text: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.text: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.

verses.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.text: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.text: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.text: By the Star when it setteth,

verses.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verses.text: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
verses.text: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
verses.text: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
verses.text: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,

verses.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.text: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.text: When he was on the uppermost horizon.

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verses.text: Then he drew nigh and came down

verses.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
verses.text: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
verses.text: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.

verses.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verses.text: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.

verses.arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verses.text: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.text: And verily he saw him yet another time

verses.arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.text: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,

verses.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
verses.text: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
verses.text: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
